name: gizza-ai/color-palette-extract
summary: Extract the dominant color palette from an image as hex codes.

tool.description: Extract the dominant color palette from an image. For each color it returns the #rrggbb hex, rgb() and hsl() strings, the r/g/b channels (0-255) and h/s/l values, and its share of the image (fraction + percent), ordered most-dominant first. Also returns a plain list of the hex codes, a ready-to-paste CSS custom-properties block (:root { --color-1: ...; }), and the image dimensions. The palette is derived from the image itself (NeuQuant), and fully transparent pixels are ignored. Use the colors parameter (1-64, default 6) to set how many colors to extract. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

colors.description: How many dominant colors to extract (1-64). Optional — defaults to 6.
